title: Tracing secret values across files and modules (#150)
description: The upstream bal-project-with-secret-tracing project. A module variable that is assigned somewhere else in the module (sharedValue, in rotation.bal) is not a fixed value. A value that stays fixed is reported where it is passed as a secret, even from another file, and a module constant is a hard-coded secret. Not available before 0.13.0.

steps.name: Secret rules only
steps.note: Upstream expects 4: main.bal ballerina:14 on lines 25 (stableValue) and 26 (rotationValue) and ballerina:13 on line 29 (vault:SHARED_CONSTANT); rotation.bal ballerina:14 on line 24. Nothing for sharedValue, which rotate() reassigns.
